basic_details.job_title: AMU Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Aligarh Muslim University (AMU) has released the official Assistant Professor Notification 2026 on its official website, https://www.amu.ac.in. A total of 3 vacancies have been announced under the AMU Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026. Candidates with a Master's degree with at least 55% marks or a Ph.D. degree from a foreign university ranked among the top 500, along with NET/SLET/SET qualification (where applicable), are eligible to apply online. The online application process is open up to 05-08-2026. The official notification PDF and online application link are available below.

age_limit.details: No minimum or maximum age limit is specified in the official notification. Age Relaxation: 5% relaxation at Bachelor's and Master's level for candidates belonging to Scheduled Caste/Schedule Tribe/Other Backward Class (Non-Creamy Layer) and Differently-Abled candidates.

qualification.education_qualification: Master's degree with 55% marks OR Ph.D. degree from a foreign university ranked among top 500. NET/SLET/SET is required unless exempted.

how_to_apply: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the AMU Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026.
Applications must be submitted online on or before 05-08-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of AMU to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of AMU to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AMU Assistant Professor recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form and printed application with documents is 05 August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Assistant Professor post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies for the Assistant Professor post in Commerce at Aligarh Muslim University.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Assistant Professor post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Master's degree with 55% marks in a relevant subject, or a Ph.D. from a foreign university ranked among the top 500. NET/SLET/SET is generally required unless exempted.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Assistant Professor position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a fixed salary of Rs. 40,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for the AMU Assistant Professor recruitment?
faq.answer: The application fee for all categories is Rs. 500.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for the Assistant Professor post at AMU?
faq.answer: You can apply online through the official careers portal of AMU. After filling the online form and making payment, you need to submit the printed application along with documents offline.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify a minimum or maximum age limit, but age relaxation is provided for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Assistant Professor role?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a screening of applications followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q9. What documents are required to be submitted with the printed application?
faq.answer: Candidates need to submit relevant self-attested documents along with the printed application form.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the Important Links section of this article.
